label: MISMATCH
rationale: Not a refactor: in G2 the four DROM rate rules were written inside the body of the private rule `DROM . seconde période` and publicodes silently dropped them (parsed rules 1258 -> 1262 after the move to `DROM . avec`), so before the commit an auto-entrepreneur in the DROM paid the full metropolitan rates (engine: BNC 231 €/mois, BIC 212, vente 123, CIPAV 1 452 €/an at 01/10/2024) and after it pays the reduced DROM rates (36 / 36 / 21 / 852). The reduction itself is what D756-5 v.LEGIARTI000034726710 (in force since 2017-05-12, Décret n°2017-972 du 9 mai 2017) requires (1/6 or 1/3, 1/2, 2/3 of the base rates, rounded up to 0,1 %), and for BIC services and vente the new constants equal D756-5 x D613-4 v.LEGIARTI000049624068 (in force 2024-07-01..2025-05-01) (3,6/10,6/14,2 and 2,1/6,2/8,2: 9 VERIFIED sophon checks). But for BNC and CIPAV the commit hard-codes 3,6/10,6/14,1 and 7,1/10,6/14,2, i.e. fractions of the superseded rates 21,1/21,2 % (D613-4 v.LEGIARTI000046714712 (in force 2022-12-10..2024-06-01; text available in store snapshot S0, not in S5)); the version in force at the decision date gives 23,1/23,2 % hence 3,9/11,6/15,4 and 7,8/11,6/15,5. The library already applies 23,1/23,2 in metropole since 07/2024, and the new DROM rules override that with date-less constants, so after the change the engine computes values the text in force does not support (8 FAILED checks, L0133-L0136, L0139-L0142). Caveat on the exact expected numbers: D756-5 still cites the pre-2020 numbering (D. 131-6-1, L. 133-6-8) and distinguishes 1/6 vs 1/3 by L. 611-1 2°, which are outside the bounded set; under any reading of the bounded texts, 3,6 % for BNC at 01/10/2024 cannot be derived from a rate table in force.
